title: fix(ui): show empty-state message when conv list window empties
context:
The Coding/Workers/Archived tab body wrapper (_archivedHtml) was always
non-empty (tools header + list div), so the _tabEmpty('sessions')
fallback never fired even when the row list itself was empty. Only the
engine-filter case had its own "No X sessions." message; a Now/1d/7d
window filtering out every row rendered a blank body under the visible
header, reading as if the list had disappeared (CCC-928).
